display_name: Awareness E3: Helpdesk reset (service desk only)
description: An eight-minute awareness episode for IT service desk staff, on the defending side only. Sit in the service desk seat at Quayholt Insurance, a fictional company: four callers want password resets or changes to their sign-in, and a sign-in prompt turns up on your own phone. Each answer is explained, and ringing back a real caller never costs you anything.
